hypothesis: Previous studies deploy too much capital at unproven breakouts, repeatedly recycle stopped capital, and anchor exits to hypothetical rather than actually owned positions. Initiate smaller funded positions, add only after actual observed profitable ownership and fresh strength, ratchet protection without widening it after a loss, and separately test volume-supported distribution warnings.

fixed_rules.rank: positive rolling 60-session log-price regression slope multiplied by its R-squared
fixed_rules.entry: close above EMA20, EMA20 above EMA60, positive 60-session return, and close at or above the highest previous entry_window closes
fixed_rules.ownership: at most four names; fresh admissions receive initial_fraction of NAV; no routine replacement or equal-weight rebalancing of intact economic units
fixed_rules.funded_gain: infer actual adjusted units from observed closing weights and account NAV, then update entry basis only for observed filled unit increases using that session's known opening fill assumptions; no target or paper gain counts as owned capital
fixed_rules.adds: at most two additions per position, each at most 15% NAV, separated by five sessions, only after at least 8% gain on observed acquisition basis and a fresh breakout; entry cap 60% except singleton 100%, drift limit 80% except singleton
fixed_rules.exit: ratchet never decreases: max(prior ratchet, observed acquisition basis * 0.92, highest owned close minus trail_atr times previous-session ATR20). A close breach, stale quote, or close below EMA60*0.98 with negative five-session return latches an exit until actual liquidation
fixed_rules.distribution: when enabled, a negative close-to-close return below -3%, current volume > 1.5 times prior-20-session average, close in bottom 30% of the day's range, and close > EMA60*1.3 creates a protective half reduction; the same distribution episode cannot repeatedly halve without a fresh ten-session high resetting the warning
fixed_rules.cash: any new protective exit starts a five-session new-money pause; blocked exits retry and do not reset the pause forever. Never recycle stop proceeds on the exit close. All reductions preserve permanent reported account high-water drawdown.
fixed_rules.execution: same incumbent close-decision / next-open cash-only engine, fees, board-lot equivalent, prior-only capacity, 1% whole-account ordinary order materiality and blocked-fill rules

selection_rule: Use training only. Prefer every-scope incumbent nonregression on wealth, maximum drawdown and filled-order count. If none qualify, minimize worst normalized deficit across these dimensions, then the original log-relative-wealth objective; label the winner diagnostic, never accepted. This necessary screen does not replace the original four-reference, crash and arbitrary-subset goals.
objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
evidence: All twenty-four candidates, causal-prefix and blocked-exit tests, actual fills, rejected predecessor families, source/data/runtime/runner identities and historical 2026 failures remain traceable. No stock IDs or known crash dates enter the policy. No new product stage/version labels.
